text:
Samir (eng-oncall): RCA published: https://redwood.internal/rca/2798765432 — summary + action items. Please read and react :eyes: 
Priya (ops): TL;DR: transient nvpeer driver mismatch + an edge case in the autoscaler led to sustained queueing on the west-us pool. Customer impact ~45m for ~12% of requests. No data exfil.
Jordan (pm): Thanks — does the doc include the customer-facing timeline we agreed on?
Samir (eng-oncall): Yes — see section 2.1. Quick highlights copied below for folks skimming: 
```
Key facts:
- Root cause: driver/firmware mismatch + autoscaler race on scale-down
- Impact window: 2026-03-20 03:12–03:57 UTC
- Affected pool: west-us gpu-pool-3 (mixed A100/RTX)
- Customer-facing notice: sent at 04:10 UTC
```
Action items (owners & checkpoints):
- Marta: pin drivers/firmware on west-us pool and rollout by 2026-03-22 EOD.
- Priya: confirm customer notices and follow-up for SLA credits by 2026-03-21 noon PT.
- Samir: add autoscaler regression test and replay (PR + CI) by 2026-03-25.
- Jordan: update runbook with the new fallback path and test procedure by 2026-03-24.
- Nina: prioritize a postmortem retro and resource allocation for dedup of mixed-hardware pools (meeting scheduled).

Priya (ops): Office hours to review RCA + triage action items: 2026-03-22 16:00 PT. Calendar invite: https://calendar.internal/redwood/event/RCADebrief2798765432 
Marta (eng-sre): I picked up the driver pin task. Will post a short deployment plan and rollback steps by EOD tomorrow.
Samir (eng-oncall): For quick visibility, I'm adding the minimal mitigation we shipped in prod: `scale-in-threshold = 120s` and temporary sticky routing away from gpu-pool-3 for canary traffic.
DeployBot: Deploy 2026-03-20 04:02 UTC — mitigations applied to west-us (deploy-id: dpl-8392).
Jordan (pm): Quick Q: who owns verifying the canary rollback path once drivers are pinned?
Marta (eng-sre): I'll run the canary verification and post results in this thread. ETA 2026-03-23 10:00 PT.
Nina (vp-eng): Thanks everyone. Two asks: (1) Priya — please include the customer impact summary in the next external post; (2) Samir/Marta — please ensure CI test covers mixed-hardware scaling scenario.
Priya (ops): Acked. I'll draft the external note and share for review by 2026-03-21 09:30 PT.
Samir (eng-oncall): Please react with :white_check_mark: once you've read and taken ownership of any action items assigned to you. I'll track in the action tracker.
Marta (eng-sre): :white_check_mark:
Priya (ops): :white_check_mark:
Jordan (pm): :white_check_mark:
Nina (vp-eng): :white_check_mark:
Samir (eng-oncall): Closing note: we'll do a short retro (30m) after the office hours to capture follow-ups. If you think anything else should be an action item, add it here or ping me directly.
